meta.description: Costed proposals of files 07, 11, 15 and 16 with claimed and independent amounts and conversions into the site yardsticks (computed from figures.json).
meta.conventions: Decimal points and no thousands separators in JSON numbers; French formatting (comma decimal, narrow no-break space) is applied at render time. EUR bn = billions of euros, current prices. Every share says % of GDP or % of total public expenditure.

sign_convention: Positive EUR bn = improves the public balance (yield or saving); negative = worsens it (cost). Conversions keep the sign.
